message.description: Human-readable explanation; do not parse for program logic.

code.description: HTTP status code repeated in the response body.

ticker.description: Currency ticker shared across networks, such as USDT.

network.description: Payment network identifier; empty for fiat.

contractAddress.description: Token contract address when applicable, otherwise null.

type.description: Currency category: stablecoin, fiat or token.

internalTicker.description: Unique ticker including network when applicable, such as USDT_TRON.

updated_at.description: Last invoice update time in UTC.

expires_at.description: Invoice expiration time in UTC, or null when not set.

api_source.description: API integration that created the invoice; native public API creates billions.

status.description: Current lifecycle state; see operation description for state meanings.

currency.description: Current invoice currency; may be network-specific after payment selection.

amount.description: Original invoice amount as a decimal string.

final_amount.description: Payer-facing amount after invoice fees as a decimal string.

merchant_fee.description: Merchant fee as a decimal string in settlement currency.

network_and_other_fees.description: Network and other payment fees as a decimal string.

merchant_receive_amount.description: Estimated amount credited to merchant, as a decimal string.

paid_amount.description: Amount actually received so far, as a decimal string.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional merchant-scoped retry key. Trimmed; an existing key returns the original invoice even if the new body differs. No length or character limit is currently enforced. The Idempotency-Key header is a fallback.

currency.description: Supported currency ticker (for example EUR, USD, USDT) or network-specific internal ticker from GET /public/v1/currencies.

amount.description: Positive finite invoice amount in the requested currency. Numeric strings are accepted. Zero, negative, nonnumeric or amounts outside merchant-specific minimum/maximum limits return 400.

type.description: Invoice audience: b2c (default) or b2b. Other values return 400.

order_no.description: Optional merchant order reference; whitespace is trimmed. Multiple invoices may share an order number.

description.description: Optional invoice description shown with the order.

autoconvert.description: Optional target balance currency, without a network suffix (for example EUR or USDT). Unsupported values return 400.

callbackUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) webhook destination. Invalid protocols or malformed URLs return 400.

success_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) success redirect, 6-255 characters; malformed values return 400. Redirect alone does not confirm payment.

return_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) return redirect, 6-255 characters; malformed values return 400.

fail_url.description: Optional HTTP(S) failure redirect, 6-255 characters; malformed values return 400.

expiresAt.description: Optional parseable date/time (ISO 8601 with timezone recommended). Invalid dates return 400; omitted or empty uses creation time plus two hours.

fee.description: Platform fee deducted from merchant proceeds.

summaryFee.description: Optional aggregate fee, included only in development mode.

merchantReceiveAmount.description: Estimated amount credited to the merchant.

currency.description: Currency ticker or network-specific internal ticker from GET /public/v1/currencies.

amount.description: Positive finite amount; numeric strings are accepted. Invalid values or amounts outside merchant-specific invoice limits return 400.

type.description: Optional b2b or b2c invoice type.

order_no.description: Optional order reference; not used to calculate fees.

description.description: Optional description; not used to calculate fees.

autoconvert.description: Optional settlement target; this estimate calculates invoice fees, not a guaranteed conversion quote.

amount.description: Requested payout amount as a decimal string.

status.description: created -> pending/processing -> success or rejected; intermediate provider states can differ.

reason.description: Merchant or administrator reason, if recorded.

is_manual.description: Whether manual payout handling is required.

payout_processor_id.description: Payout provider request identifier, if submitted.

payout_processor_error.description: Latest provider error text, if any.

payout_processor_tx_id.description: Blockchain or payout transaction identifier, when available.

payout_processor_initialized_at.description: Time the payout provider was first called.

updated_at.description: Last request update time in UTC.

finished_at.description: Terminal-state time, or null while outstanding.

page.description: One-based current page. Values below one are normalized to one.

pageSize.description: Items per page, capped at 200; default 20.

total.description: Number of matching requests across all pages.

amount.description: Refund amount as a decimal string.

to_address.description: Crypto recipient address, or null for fiat refunds.

withdraw_to_same_address.description: Whether recipient was derived from the single incoming invoice transaction.

status.description: new -> processing -> refunded, failed or declined.

reason.description: Reason supplied for the refund, if any.

refunded_at.description: Completion time for a successful refund, or null.

payout_processor_id.description: Payout provider request identifier, if submitted.

payout_processor_error.description: Latest provider error text, if any.

payout_processor_tx_id.description: Blockchain or payout transaction identifier, when available.

post.description: Create a hosted invoice. It starts pending, may move to processing during payment confirmation, then completed when paid. Compliance review may insert aml_check and resolve to completed or aml_block. An unpaid invoice may become expired or failed; a paid invoice may move through refund_processing to refunded. Provider or administrator actions can skip intermediate states. Status changes asynchronously; use GET or signed webhooks rather than redirect visits to confirm payment.
